##### SECTION Z6 (encryption and encryptionroot of a raw copy, a raw child under a raw parent, plain under an encrypted target, plain under an unencrypted target)  tag=C  zfs-2.2.2-0ubuntu9.5
=== CASE Z6/00_sources
--- cmd
zfs get -H -o name,property,value encryption,encryptionroot,keystatus,keylocation,keyformat zfsbcapc/Z6/cs/ep zfsbcapc/Z6/cs/ep/ec zfsbcapc/Z6/cs/pl
--- rc
0
--- stdout
zfsbcapc/Z6/cs/ep	encryption	aes-256-gcm
